Both libraries are implemented in the Blue workspace; no sibling checkout, gitlink or original C++ production dependency. References, licenses and provenance are intact.
Every file/body/configuration and consumed external contract has a justified disposition. No unresolved required region or silently reduced applicability set remains.

Every required Blue-specific entity/responsibility has exactly one canonical Rust counterpart. Behavioral, structural and nominal correspondence all hold, including names, public/private boundaries, owners, interfaces, bases, overrides and shared state.
Forward/reverse source-to-Rust reconciliation is current, with no canonical collisions, missing bodies, unowned production items or unsupported relationship claims.
PyO3 replacements are explicit; Blue-specific discovery, registration, type/object identity, conversion, properties, callbacks, copying, persistence and lifecycle are implemented.
Every applicable subsystem has a real vertical/horizontal production path with authoritative state, scheduling, resources and callback semantics. Headless Linux works.

Default runtime is free-threaded with recorded GIL state after required imports. Ownership, borrowing, tasklet/context behavior, parallel work, async boundaries, cancellation and shutdown preserve required contracts.
The current Linux host/target is identified; the core avoids unnecessary OS/distribution/version coupling. Required platform adapters and future Windows/macOS obligations are explicit.

The Bevy version meets the timestamped newest-stable gate. Compatible maintained Rust/CPython/PyO3 dependencies are pinned. Deprecated production macros and recreated generic binding machinery are absent.
Every required native/extension/embedding/adapter mode builds. Actual final packages install with their required contents and correct artifact identities.

Complete applicable original suites/configurations execute successfully against the candidate, subject only to exact approved exceptions. Required skipped, missing, blocked, zero-case, interrupted or stale results do not count as passes.
Review/build/test/package receipts match current semantic inputs and actual artifacts. Discovery, loaded modules, configurations, results and freshness are reconciled.
Completed milestones are integrated into remote blue-rs-dev with evidence valid for that content. Visible checkout, main, upstream BlueExposure and unrelated work are accounted for and preserved.
Queue, checkpoint, committed generation and live Goal agree. No required placeholder, omitted method, empty callback, hidden disabled feature, unapproved exception or unfinished obligation remains.
Every required Blue-specific entity and responsibility has one canonical counterpart.
Behavioral, structural and nominal equivalence apply simultaneously.
Preserve names, state/method owners, interfaces, bases, overrides and responsibilities.
Use Rust structs/traits/supertraits/composition and distinguish logical ownership from actual impl items.
Inventory both complete libraries, private bodies, configurations and exposure machinery.
One Blue-rooted Cargo workspace contains both Rust implementations and pinned references.
Reuse maintained PyO3 directly and retain only required Blue-specific adapters/policy.
Modernize mechanisms while preserving defined observable Blue behavior.
Bevy owns substantive vertical/horizontal execution and state integration.
Newest stable Bevy is resolved, pinned and rechecked at a dated final gate.
Free-threaded concurrent, parallel, async and multithreaded Python is the default.
Canonical synchronous contracts remain; async adapters are additional infrastructure.
Deprecated production macros are replaced with maintained facilities.
Tooling serves fastest complete delivery; CGP/generation and handwritten Rust are optional.
Successful compilation and original tests remain the verification standard.
Preserve original tests and require exact approval for semantic changes or retirement.
Linux/current-host acceptance comes first; portable design remains required and Windows/macOS remain future obligations.
Use native Goal lifecycle, one queue/checkpoint and durable, current evidence.
Publish verified milestones to blue-rs-dev while preserving main and upstream BlueExposure.
Preserve user guidance and unrelated implementation work, including concurrent writers.
Prompt authoring/review does not activate implementation or silently replace an active contract.
Report evidence channels, exceptions and publication separately; never call them formal proof.

**Authority and scope closed:** original Destiny, consumed original Blue/BlueExposure, overlays, files/bodies/macros/templates/configurations and finite provider closure are pinned and accounted for; no required unresolved region or silent denominator reduction remains.

**Bijection and naming satisfied:** all required source entities/responsibilities have exactly one real canonical counterpart; actual declarations and expansions reconcile both ways; mechanical names, properties/fields/constants/registrations and logical/concrete owners are correct; auxiliary items are classified.

**Relationship and identity semantics satisfied:** complete base/interface/override graphs, inherited behavior, shared state, runtime identity, queries, copying and lifecycle have actual source-compatible paths, including the `Ball`, `Ballpark` and `IEveReferencePoint` examples.

**All Destiny behavior implemented:** every world/host/client/server/private/configuration obligation has a real body and correct responsibility owner. No TODO, missing delegate, unconditional success, disabled required feature, empty shell or state-only facade remains.

**Current Blue integration complete:** reproducible current Blue dependency, consumed providers, bounded fixes, actual registration/exposure/runtime access and one runtime/state authority across Python, interfaces, Destiny and Bevy are complete. No older nested baseline or undocumented sibling input remains.

**Bevy integration complete:** all subsystem vertical/horizontal records point to real production execution/state, with compatible versions, final finite version gate, headless Linux operation, clock/schedule/callback/resource semantics and no duplicate physical-state authority.

**Python and concurrency contracts complete:** free-threaded default and actual GIL state after required imports, canonical synchronous completion, public type graph, receiver contention, reentrancy, loop/task context, identity/weakrefs/GC, errors/cancellation, interpreter ownership and shutdown are implemented and reviewed with explicit original-test coverage/limits.

**Public boundaries and implementation quality complete:** stable canonical public APIs, private providers/plumbing, native Rust mechanisms, idiomatic Rust/Bevy refactoring and reproducible generation/recorded handwritten ownership are complete.

**Production builds and formats complete:** required actual-host configurations and artifact modes compile; stream/snapshot/replay/wire formats and references preserve required semantics; dependency/toolchain/ABI identities and future-platform obligations are accurate.

**Original-test accounting complete:** every source occurrence has a justified disposition; every required applicable executable case passes against the intended installed Rust/Blue candidate or has an exact execution exception. Missing/zero execution, failures, unapproved skips, timeouts and unresolved C++ adapter routes cannot pass.

**Evidence and decisions current:** source review, reconciliation, build, original-test, package and publication receipts form a continuous current chain; no required pending decision, stale inherited credit or fabricated proof result remains. Additional verification exists only within its authorization.

**Installed deliverables complete:** reproducible packages, native/Python interfaces, data, licenses, build/use instructions and original-test execution use the real installed candidate, with no original C++ production runtime dependency or stale import shadowing.

**Guidance and architecture complete:** exact root-byte mirrors and CI sync/check operate under the maintained-directory boundary; references/user work are preserved; architecture views/ADRs reflect actual code and accurately state ISO alignment and evidence limits.

**Integrated publication complete:** verified Destiny milestones are integrated into `destiny-rs-dev`; required bounded Blue contributions are separately reviewed/integrated into `blue-rs-dev`; actual remote content matches validated semantic inputs; local/remote/visible-checkout state and any exact publication exception are reported.

**Operational closure complete:** canonical queue/generation and continuation reconcile all required obligations; no required `planned`, `partial`, `unresolved`, stale or blocked item remains; native Goal is bound to the adopted contract and only then marked complete under supported lifecycle rules.
